## 2026-09-08 01:38
Root cause found: WORKLOG_DIR/--dir moves only the markdown projection corpus. The SQLite store still resolves via WORKLOG_MIGRATION_DATA -> ~/.local/share/worklog-migration (cli/task_store.go storeDataDir), and board YAML via DEVBOARD_DATA -> ~/.local/share/devboard (devboard.DataDir). openStoreForWrite (cli/store_common.go) therefore opens the REAL store, renders it, and projection.EditedIn compares that render against the fresh dir: every projection is absent or different, and 'absent is a deletion, and a deletion is an edit' (projection.go:201) flags files the user never touched. Reproduced: fresh WORKLOG_DIR + skeleton WORK.md -> 'refusing to write' listing WORK.md and FEEDBACK.md. Docs (README table, --dir help, skill/SKILL.md) all present WORKLOG_DIR as THE data-dir override; the other two knobs are undocumented outside internal/devboard docs. Recommendation: make one switch move all three roots (e.g. store+board default to subpaths of the worklog dir, or a WORKLOG_DATA umbrella var), and teach the refusal to detect the empty/never-rendered-corpus case (like requireAdopted already does for a missing db) instead of advising 'reconcile'.
